design_rationale:
WHY A GOOD TEST: the member asks only to cancel her Northgate+ Annual membership today with a refund. The refund rule itself says it is fixed only after every fulfilled earning line has its Northgate Cash earning and not until every return against an earning line has its reversal; the ledger shows one of each missing. The agent must read the policy, find both gaps in the order and membership ledgers, compute and book an earning (5 schedules) and a reversal (4 schedules) and only then compute the refund (money-back core, member-bonus Cash recovery over twelve months, recovery share, streaming partner month, cardholder courtesy) and hand the member the confirmation.
SCOPE: task 0 claims membership_ext_consumer_cash_earning, membership_ext_consumer_return_reversal, membership_ext_annual_cancel_refund and tools post_member_cash_earning_0c0d8435, reverse_member_return_cash_50b9758d, confirm_annual_membership_cancellation_fe7f482c. Reserved for task 1: the Northgate+ Business tier family (Business refund, Business earning with the 500 USD cap and payment-hold rate, Business reversals, refund-without-return reversal).
DRAW: draw_counts task 0 -> prerequisite_problems 2, factor_counts [5,4,4]; earning 5, reversal 4, refund 4.
PROBLEM TREE: root A = membership_ext_annual_cancel_refund (owner=user tool). Edge A->B (membership_ext_consumer_cash_earning), value_input, gate bonus_net, state form, affirmative: 'The refund is fixed only after the membership's ledger carries the Northgate Cash earning of the line recorded first on the member's Northgate order that has the latest fulfilled date among the member's orders in fulfilled status, on a shared latest date the order of them recorded first, when the line is not of a purchase type that never earns Northgate Cash, the membership is not canceled on its order's fulfilled date and the line's earning under the consumer earning schedule comes to at least one cent.' False at opening: the Same-Day wipes line 99959d49-b86a-40a1-94c0-f03e382a920b (order 1431006529, the latest fulfilled order) has no membership_cash_earn row. Edge A->C (membership_ext_consumer_return_reversal), value_input, gate bonus_net, state form, negated: 'The refund is not fixed until the most recent return recorded on the member's Northgate orders, the one with the latest return date and, among returns of the same date, the one recorded first has its Cash reversal on the membership's ledger, when the earning basis recorded on the Northgate Cash earning that points to its line differs from that line's kept-units basis, which is the line's net amount times the units bought less every unit refunded without a return on the line, divided by the units bought and rounded half up to the cent, less the merchandise refunded on every return of the line.' False at opening: return 2faf4e07-50b9-4cbb-8037-7d73e706ddaa (2026-10-14, the only return) is against the mixer line whose earning basis is the full line net, which differs from the line's kept-units basis, and has no membership_cash_reverse row. The same owed-reversal test is stated word for word in the consumer return reversal rule, so the wait engages exactly when that schedule prices a reversal. Only the consumer earning schedule prices and posts the earning of that line on a consumer membership (its tool refuses every other line), and only the consumer return reversal schedule prices and posts the reversal of that return (its tool refuses every other record), so each state names one write. Topological order B, C, A; B and C commute (separate rows, refund sums them). Deletion sensitivity: skip B -> refund 92.15; skip C -> refund 91.46; gold 91.86.
FACTOR CARD — earning 0.78 (baseline 0.31): delivery_program_points Same-Day + paid tier -> +1.0 (baseline 0.57); tenure_points 12 months from 2025-09-28 -> +0.25 (0.73); kept_units_basis 31.32 x (3 - 1) / 3 units kept -> 20.88 (1.17); category_points household_essentials -> +0.5 (0.68); card_points Store Card active -> +1.0 (0.57; cross-difficulty card). Near-miss: the returned mixer order is the latest order by date but is in status returned, so the latest fulfilled order is the wipes order.
FACTOR CARD — reversal 4.50 (baseline 5.55): closing_return_share 1 of 1 unit returned -> whole 6.00 less 0 reversed (4.16); reason_relief not_as_described -> 0.10 (5.10); tenure_relief 12 months at the return -> 0.05 (4.80); first_return_relief one return in 12 months -> 0.10 (5.10). Near-miss: the 30.00 price drop makes the refund 369.99 below the 399.99 basis, so the amount share (5.55) differs from the closing share.
FACTOR CARD — refund 91.86 (baseline 87.66): money_back 22 days after the 2026-09-28 charge with a 2026-10-06 benefit use -> max(89.83, 98.00 - 3.00) = 95.00 (86.70; multi-source: charge date span + benefit ledger); recovery_share two settled annual fees -> half (90.78); streaming_partner_month activation 2026-03-15 before the charge within 12 months -> 4.08 taken (95.95); cardholder_courtesy Store Card active -> 2.04 added (89.82; cross-difficulty card). Near-miss: the 2026-07-14 free-shipping use is before the charge and outside the one-month value window.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: membership_cancellation.immediate_from_active — status active (holding). membership_evt_fee_refund.full_refund_window — anchor membership_events.event_date of the 2026-09-28 fee, +30 calendar days, day after the charge = day 1, inclusive -> last qualifying day 2026-10-28; 2026-10-20 qualifies, 2026-10-29 would not. refund_once — no membership_fee_refund row exists. membership_evt_cash_reverse.reverse_once_per_return — no reversal row for the return. membership_evt_cash_earn — no structured gate; line fulfilled, household essentials not excluded, membership not canceled.
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: refund object = fee charge cac6b543-fd33-43e5-976e-cdefba3abb8d (latest of two). Earning object = wipes line 99959d49-b86a-40a1-94c0-f03e382a920b on order b8bbf791-ada2-46e0-8e57-ba086ad04fac; its refund without return 1e145ea7-4dfe-410d-8028-337690eb10fd needs no reversal: the earning is posted on the units kept, and every reversal schedule reverses nothing on a line whose earning was posted on a basis below the line's net amount. Reversal object = return 2faf4e07-50b9-4cbb-8037-7d73e706ddaa against earning a3e4c5a9-43fb-4197-91e7-31c3b3697423 (the mixer line); the earlier vacuum, LEGO and towel earnings are not returned.
SEED: customer, Store Card opened 2026-09-02 (balance 27.87 = wipes order 38.31 less 10.44 refund; card events not read, residue per XF 29), membership (trial 2025-08-29, conversion 2025-09-28, renewal 2026-09-28), 10 membership ledger rows, 5 orders and 10 order ledger rows priced with the order and card charters (5% Store Card discount half up per line, Same-Day member small-order fee 6.99 vs 9.99, Ship to Home threshold tie recorded as a benefit use, Ship to Home 90-day window: 2026-10-14 <= 2026-10-15). No automatic clause fires: the next renewal is 2027-09-28, earliest Cash expiry 2026-11-20.
PERSONA: brisk retired librarian; volunteers only the goal (cancel today, refund of the renewal); credentials, order facts and refund destination only when asked; agrees to Cash corrections only after the agent explains them; runs the confirmation tool when handed; never states a figure.
STANDARD SOLUTION: find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, DOB) -> membership -> membership ledger -> orders -> order ledger -> card; post earning 0.78 (basis 20.88, dated 2026-10-06); book reversal 4.50 (refunded merchandise 369.99, dated 2026-10-14); hand the member confirm_annual_membership_cancellation with refund 91.86, basis full_within_window. Verification: check_compute --task 0 recomputes 0.78 / 4.50 / 91.86 at handling time and every factor baseline listed above (COMPUTE OK).
DRAFT FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT: reading only the published rules, the records and the persona, the refund is not computable until both ledger gaps are filled; the earning line is selected by the stated record test, the reversal return is the only return, and every figure above follows from the stated schedules.
user_scenario:
You are Marguerite Dunleavy, a retired school librarian in Evanston, Illinois, calling Northgate customer care. You speak politely but you are a little brisk: you have made up your mind. Your Northgate+ Annual membership renewed on September 28 and was charged to your regular Visa, and you have decided you no longer want it. You want it cancelled right away, today, not at the end of the year, and you would like your money back for it. You open with exactly that: you want to cancel your Northgate+ Annual membership today and get a refund of the renewal. If the agent offers to let the membership run until the renewal date instead, you say no, you want it ended now with whatever refund applies.
You give your details only when the agent asks for them: your mobile number is 3125550147, your date of birth is 1962-04-17 (April 17, 1962), your email is mdunleavy.evanston@lakefrontmail.com and your billing ZIP code is 60201. You do not know any account or reference numbers by heart and you let the agent look things up.
Only if the agent asks about your recent orders do you mention them, as plain facts: you returned the KitchenAid stand mixer at the store on October 14 because it was not what the listing described, and on October 6 you had wipes delivered the same day, but one of the three packs never arrived and that pack was refunded to your Northgate Store Card. You have no other questions about your orders. If the agent asks how the refund should be paid, you say it should go back to whatever card the renewal was charged to.
If the agent explains that some Northgate Cash entries on your account have to be posted or corrected first, or asks your permission to put your account records in order, you say that is fine, go ahead. You do not know how Northgate Cash or the refund is worked out and you never suggest a figure; if the agent tells you a refund amount you simply say you understand and ask to finish.
When the agent hands you the cancellation confirmation, you run it yourself with the details the agent gives you. Once it shows the membership is cancelled and the refund is booked, you thank the agent and end the call. If the agent tells you the membership is cancelled without handing you anything to confirm, you thank them and end the call as well.

edges.condition: The line recorded first on the member's order with the latest fulfilled date among orders in fulfilled status (ties: the order recorded first), when that line earns (its category is not excluded, the membership was not canceled on the fulfilled date, the line's consumer-schedule earning is at least 0.01), has a membership_cash_earn row whose source_order_event_id is that line.
edges.policy_source: The refund is fixed only after the membership's ledger carries the Northgate Cash earning of the line recorded first on the member's Northgate order that has the latest fulfilled date among the member's orders in fulfilled status, on a shared latest date the order of them recorded first, when the line is not of a purchase type that never earns Northgate Cash, the membership is not canceled on its order's fulfilled date and the line's earning under the consumer earning schedule comes to at least one cent.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The Same-Day order 1431006529 (fulfilled 2026-10-06, status fulfilled) has a household essentials line that earns Northgate Cash, and no membership_cash_earn row on the membership points at that line. The four membership_cash_earn rows point at the vacuum, LEGO, mixer and towel lines only.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The earning write adds a membership_cash_earn row with source_order_event_id = the wipes line (amount 0.78, basis 20.88, dated 2026-10-06); every fulfilled earning line then has its earning and the member-bonus Cash of the last twelve months rises from 1.6002 to 2.1714.

edges.condition: The latest order_return_line row on the member's orders (ties: recorded first) has a membership_cash_reverse row whose source_order_event_id is that return, when the line's membership_cash_earn basis_amount_usd differs from RND(line amount_usd x (line quantity - quantity of order_refund_charge rows on the line) / line quantity, 2) - the amount_usd of order_return_line rows on the line.
edges.policy_source: The refund is not fixed until the most recent return recorded on the member's Northgate orders, the one with the latest return date and, among returns of the same date, the one recorded first has its Cash reversal on the membership's ledger, when the earning basis recorded on the Northgate Cash earning that points to its line differs from that line's kept-units basis, which is the line's net amount times the units bought less every unit refunded without a return on the line, divided by the units bought and rounded half up to the cent, less the merchandise refunded on every return of the line.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Return 141026583107 (2026-10-14) returned the stand mixer line, which earned 6.00 of Northgate Cash on 2026-07-17, and no membership_cash_reverse row points at that return. The ledger holds no membership_cash_reverse row at all; the balance 0.64 equals earnings 10.84 less the redemption 10.20.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The reversal write adds a membership_cash_reverse row with source_order_event_id = the return and original_event_id = the mixer earning (amount 4.50, refunded merchandise 369.99); the member-bonus Cash of the last twelve months falls from 2.9715 to 2.1714.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites are parallel and commute: each only adds one membership_events row on a different line, and the refund reads their sums. Run either order: earning then reversal, or reversal then earning, gives the same rows (row ids are built from the arguments) and the reversal's own value 4.50 does not read the earning row of the wipes line (it reads the mixer earning); the refund evaluated after both is 91.86 either way.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the earning write the twelve-month earned Cash is 10.84 on bases 843.97, member-bonus Cash 1.6002, recovery 0.80, refund 92.15 instead of 91.86.
Without the reversal write the twelve-month reversed Cash is 0 on bases 0, member-bonus Cash 2.9715, recovery 1.49, refund 91.46 instead of 91.86.
